verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only glancing support. Weave says it can 'trace, version' application functions and captures op code automatically, and its Playground supports prompt editing and saved model presets. Nothing shows a prompt registry or a way to promote prompt versions to production without a code change. Missing for 10: dedicated prompt versioning objects or registry, runtime fetching of prompts by label or alias, deploying prompt changes to production without a code release, rollback or environment promotion, independent corroboration.
